$comment: Only used on windows, and only when the build is pointed at vcpkg's
toolchain file - which is what the release workflow does. A plain
cmake -S . -B build ignores this file, and cmake/FindOrInstallPostgreSQL.cmake
installs libpq the classic way instead.
No builtin-baseline on purpose: the versions then come from the baseline of
the vcpkg checkout in use, and the workflow is what pins that checkout.
Adding a baseline here is worth doing once a known-good vcpkg commit exists
to name; a wrong hash fails the configure step outright.
name: sqt
description: Scriptable SQL client for PostgreSQL and ODBC data sources
